_comment: KATOMIA-CONFIG1 (2026-07-14): site-wide, non-secret config. Not build/deploy secrets — deliberately git-tracked (see .gitignore's narrow negation of the blanket *.json rule for this one file) so it's administrable/reviewable like any other code. Lives inside m/katomia/ on purpose: the user wants everything Katomia-related self-contained in this one folder so a future white-label deploy (a separate site, its own config) or a relocation/bundle only ever has to carry this folder. Extend this file (not a second one) for future site-wide settings — default skin, branding, etc.
